findings.description: The requirement specifies the result at exactly the start limit, but its cited verification constraint CON-SUP-127 calls for test margins of at least 200 µs on either side of the limit. A test using those margins does not establish the behavior at equality.
findings.requested_change: Resolve with the product owner how equality is to be verified while satisfying CON-SUP-127, and record the resulting verification conditions or open point.
